title: 海水溫差發電熱交換器
titleEn: Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion Heat Exchangers
subcategoryTitle: 海洋能與地熱系統技術
subcategoryTitleEn: Ocean energy and geothermal system technology
summary: 海水溫差發電利用熱帶海洋表層二十幾度的暖水與一千公尺深處四五度的冷水之間的溫差來推動熱機。因為溫差太小，理論效率只有百分之七，實際不到百分之三；要發一點電，就得讓巨量的海水流過巨大的熱交換器——熱交換器因此是整座電廠成本與成敗的關鍵。課程以夏威夷的示範電廠為背景，定量分析有效溫差、所需的海水與氨流量、換熱面積、生物污垢與泵功。
summaryEn: Ocean thermal energy conversion runs a heat engine on the difference between tropical surface water above twenty degrees and water at four or five degrees a thousand metres down. With so small a difference theoretical efficiency is only seven percent and real efficiency under three; a little power needs vast seawater flow through vast heat exchangers, which therefore decide cost and success of the whole plant. Set against the demonstration plant in Hawaii, the course quantifies effective temperature difference, seawater and ammonia flow, exchanger area, biofouling and pumping power.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 只有二十度溫差可用的熱機：有效溫差、海水流量、熱交換面積、污垢與泵功
v30FocusEn: A heat engine with only twenty degrees to work with: effective temperature difference, seawater flow, exchanger area, fouling and pumping

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：海水溫差發電熱交換器
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion Heat Exchangers
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「海水溫差與所需流量」與「有效溫差與實際效率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ocean thermal gradient and required flow" and "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「海水溫差與所需流量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ocean thermal gradient and required flow" is correct?
options: 熱帶海洋表層約 25 至 28 °C，一千公尺深處只有 4 至 5 °C，海洋溫差發電（OTEC）就利用這約 20 °C 的溫差驅動熱機。
海洋溫差發電的熱源是整片海洋，所以效率一定很高。
海水有二十度的溫差，就全部可以用來發電。
optionsEn: Tropical surface water is about 25–28 °C and water a thousand metres down only 4–5 °C; ocean thermal energy conversion drives a heat engine with this difference of about 20 °C.
The heat source of OTEC is the whole ocean, so its efficiency must be high.
With twenty degrees between waters, all of it is available for power.
quiz.explanation: 熱帶海洋表層約 25 至 28 °C，一千公尺深處只有 4 至 5 °C，海洋溫差發電（OTEC）就利用這約 20 °C 的溫差驅動熱機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tropical surface water is about 25–28 °C and water a thousand metres down only 4–5 °C; ocean thermal energy conversion drives a heat engine with this difference of about 20 °C. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 海水溫差與所需流量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Ocean thermal gradient and required flow: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「海水溫差與所需流量」如何決定「海水溫差發電熱交換器」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ocean thermal gradient and required flow” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion Heat Exchangers”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 熱帶海洋表層約 25 至 28 °C，一千公尺深處只有 4 至 5 °C，海洋溫差發電（OTEC）就利用這約 20 °C 的溫差驅動熱機。溫差這麼小，卡諾效率只有 7% 左右，扣除熱交換溫差與泵的耗電後淨效率僅約 2% 至 3%，因此每發 1 MW 電要抽取每秒數立方公尺的冷、暖海水。直徑數公尺、長一公里的冷水管與巨大的熱交換面積，是工程與成本的核心。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tropical surface water is about 25–28 °C and water a thousand metres down only 4–5 °C; ocean thermal energy conversion drives a heat engine with this difference of about 20 °C. So small a difference gives a Carnot efficiency near 7% and, after heat-exchanger temperature drops and pumping power, a net efficiency of only about 2–3%, so each megawatt needs cubic metres per second of cold and warm seawater. A cold-water pipe metres across and a kilometre long and vast heat-exchange area are the core of engineering and cost. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：夏威夷的示範電廠容量約 100 kW，2015 年 8 月併網
steps.observationEn: Project file: The Hawaii demonstration plant of about 100 kW was connected in August 2015
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「海洋溫差發電的熱源是整片海洋，所以效率一定很高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The heat source of OTEC is the whole ocean, so its efficiency must be high." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「海水溫差與所需流量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Ocean thermal gradient and required flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：海洋溫差發電的熱源是整片海洋，所以效率一定很高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「海水溫差與所需流量」的模型 η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h，表層暖水與深層冷水之間的卡諾效率最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h for "Ocean thermal gradient and required flow", which value is closest to the carnot efficiency between warm surface water and cold deep water?
quiz.explanation: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 5 °C、Thot = 26 °C，得 7.02 %（表層暖水與深層冷水之間的卡諾效率）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 5 °C, Thot = 26 °C the result is 7.02 % (carnot efficiency between warm surface water and cold deep water). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 海水溫差與所需流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ocean thermal gradient and required flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「海水溫差與所需流量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Ocean thermal gradient and required flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 5 °C、Thot = 26 °C，得 7.02 %（表層暖水與深層冷水之間的卡諾效率）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Thot 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 5 °C, Thot = 26 °C the result is 7.02 % (carnot efficiency between warm surface water and cold deep water). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Thot by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Thot 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.82 %（+11.4%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Thot by 10% changes the result to 7.82 % (+11.4%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 7.02 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Thot 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 7.02 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Thot with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 5 °C、Thot = 26 °C，得 7.02 %（表層暖水與深層冷水之間的卡諾效率）。
knowledge.textEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 5 °C, Thot = 26 °C the result is 7.02 % (carnot efficiency between warm surface water and cold deep water).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Thot 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.82 %（+11.4%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Thot by 10% changes the result to 7.82 % (+11.4%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「海水溫差與所需流量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ocean thermal gradient and required flow"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
只要塗了防鏽漆，海裡的鋼結構就不會生鏽。
以溫鹽深儀（CTD）量測全年的垂直溫度剖面，並在示範電廠量測冷暖水流量、熱交換器端差與泵耗電，求得毛出力與淨出力。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once painted, steel in the sea will not rust.

Measure vertical temperature profiles through the year with a CTD, and at a demonstration plant measure cold and warm water flow, heat-exchanger approach temperatures and pumping power to obtain gross and net output.
quiz.explanation: 以溫鹽深儀（CTD）量測全年的垂直溫度剖面，並在示範電廠量測冷暖水流量、熱交換器端差與泵耗電，求得毛出力與淨出力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure vertical temperature profiles through the year with a CTD, and at a demonstration plant measure cold and warm water flow, heat-exchanger approach temperatures and pumping power to obtain gross and net output. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 海水溫差與所需流量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ocean thermal gradient and required flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「海水溫差與所需流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ocean thermal gradient and required flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以溫鹽深儀（CTD）量測全年的垂直溫度剖面，並在示範電廠量測冷暖水流量、熱交換器端差與泵耗電，求得毛出力與淨出力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure vertical temperature profiles through the year with a CTD, and at a demonstration plant measure cold and warm water flow, heat-exchanger approach temperatures and pumping power to obtain gross and net output. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：熱交換器要有連續的生物污損控制（如間歇加氯或機械清洗）並逐日追蹤熱傳係數，淨出力的定義須明確扣除所有泵功。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Heat exchangers need continuous biofouling control such as intermittent chlorination or mechanical cleaning with heat-transfer coefficient tracked daily, and net output must be defined after all pumping power.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：熱交換器海水側只要有薄薄一層生物膜，總熱傳係數就明顯下降；在溫差本來就很小的 OTEC，這會讓淨出力趨近於零。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Even a thin biofilm on the seawater side of the heat exchangers lowers the overall coefficient noticeably, and with OTEC's tiny temperature difference this can drive net output toward zero. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以溫鹽深儀（CTD）量測全年的垂直溫度剖面，並在示範電廠量測冷暖水流量、熱交換器端差與泵耗電，求得毛出力與淨出力。
knowledge.textEn: Measure vertical temperature profiles through the year with a CTD, and at a demonstration plant measure cold and warm water flow, heat-exchanger approach temperatures and pumping power to obtain gross and net output.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 熱交換器要有連續的生物污損控制（如間歇加氯或機械清洗）並逐日追蹤熱傳係數，淨出力的定義須明確扣除所有泵功。
knowledge.textEn: Heat exchangers need continuous biofouling control such as intermittent chlorination or mechanical cleaning with heat-transfer coefficient tracked daily, and net output must be defined after all pumping power.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC TS 62600 海洋能—波浪、潮流與其他水流能轉換器系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC TS 62600 series: Marine energy – Wave, tidal and other water current converters. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「海水溫差與所需流量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ocean thermal gradient and required flow" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 熱交換器海水側只要有薄薄一層生物膜，總熱傳係數就明顯下降；在溫差本來就很小的 OTEC，這會讓淨出力趨近於零。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
海水有二十度的溫差，就全部可以用來發電。
optionsEn: Even a thin biofilm on the seawater side of the heat exchangers lowers the overall coefficient noticeably, and with OTEC's tiny temperature difference this can drive net output toward zero.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
With twenty degrees between waters, all of it is available for power.
quiz.explanation: 熱交換器海水側只要有薄薄一層生物膜，總熱傳係數就明顯下降；在溫差本來就很小的 OTEC，這會讓淨出力趨近於零。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Even a thin biofilm on the seawater side of the heat exchangers lowers the overall coefficient noticeably, and with OTEC's tiny temperature difference this can drive net output toward zero. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 海水溫差與所需流量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ocean thermal gradient and required flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「海水溫差與所需流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Ocean thermal gradient and required flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 熱交換器海水側只要有薄薄一層生物膜，總熱傳係數就明顯下降；在溫差本來就很小的 OTEC，這會讓淨出力趨近於零。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「海水溫差發電熱交換器」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Even a thin biofilm on the seawater side of the heat exchangers lowers the overall coefficient noticeably, and with OTEC's tiny temperature difference this can drive net output toward zero. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion Heat Exchangers”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：直徑數公尺、長一公里的冷水管與巨大的熱交換面積，是工程與成本的核心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A cold-water pipe metres across and a kilometre long and vast heat-exchange area are the core of engineering and cost.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海洋溫差發電的熱源是整片海洋，所以效率一定很高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The heat source of OTEC is the whole ocean, so its efficiency must be high." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 熱交換器海水側只要有薄薄一層生物膜，總熱傳係數就明顯下降；在溫差本來就很小的 OTEC，這會讓淨出力趨近於零。
knowledge.textEn: Even a thin biofilm on the seawater side of the heat exchangers lowers the overall coefficient noticeably, and with OTEC's tiny temperature difference this can drive net output toward zero.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 關於「有效溫差與實際效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency" is correct?
options: 海水有二十度的溫差，就全部可以用來發電。
海水到處都是，要用多少都不成問題。
二十一度的溫差並不能全部拿來推動渦輪機。
optionsEn: With twenty degrees between waters, all of it is available for power.
Seawater is everywhere and any amount can be used without trouble.
Not all of twenty-one degrees can drive the turbine.
quiz.explanation: 二十一度的溫差並不能全部拿來推動渦輪機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Not all of twenty-one degrees can drive the turbine. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效溫差與實際效率：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective temperature difference and real efficiency: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「有效溫差與實際效率」如何決定「海水溫差發電熱交換器」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective temperature difference and real efficiency” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion Heat Exchangers”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 二十一度的溫差並不能全部拿來推動渦輪機。暖水流過蒸發器時自己要降溫兩三度，才能把熱交給氨；冷水流過冷凝器時也要升溫兩三度；熱要穿過金屬板，板的兩側又各需要兩三度的溫差來驅動。這些都是不可避免的「溫差稅」。扣掉之後，氨蒸汽在渦輪機進出口之間真正可用的溫差只剩十度左右——理論效率因此由百分之七掉到百分之三出頭，還沒有扣掉抽水的耗電。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Not all of twenty-one degrees can drive the turbine. Warm water must cool two or three degrees in the evaporator to hand its heat to ammonia; cold water warms two or three in the condenser; and heat crossing the metal plates needs two or three degrees on each side to drive it. These are unavoidable taxes on the difference. After them the difference really available to ammonia vapour across the turbine is only about ten degrees, and theoretical efficiency falls from seven percent to a little over three, before pumping power is taken off. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：表層海水約 25 至 27 °C，深層海水約 4 至 6 °C
steps.observationEn: Project file: Surface water is about 25 to 27 °C and deep water about 4 to 6 °C
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「海水有二十度的溫差，就全部可以用來發電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With twenty degrees between waters, all of it is available for power." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「有效溫差與實際效率」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Effective temperature difference and real efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Not all of twenty-one degrees can drive the turbine. Warm water must cool two or three degrees in the evaporator to hand its heat to ammonia; cold water warms two or three in the condenser; and heat crossing the metal plates needs two or three degrees on each side to drive it. These are unavoidable taxes on the difference. After them the difference really available to ammonia vapour across the turbine is only about ten degrees, and theoretical efficiency falls from seven percent to a little over three, before pumping power is taken off.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：海水有二十度的溫差，就全部可以用來發電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With twenty degrees between waters, all of it is available for power. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「有效溫差與實際效率」的模型 η = (ΔT − ΔT_loss) / T_h，總溫差 21 K、各項溫差損失合計 11 K、暖水 26 °C 時循環的效率上限最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η = (ΔT − ΔT_loss) / T_h for "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency", which value is closest to the ceiling on cycle efficiency for a total 21 K less 11 K of temperature losses with warm water at 26 °C?
quiz.explanation: η = (ΔT − ΔT_loss) / T_h；代入 dT = 21 K、dl = 11 K、Th = 26 °C，得 3.3 %（總溫差 21 K、各項溫差損失合計 11 K、暖水 26 °C 時循環的效率上限）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η = (ΔT − ΔT_loss) / T_h; with dT = 21 K, dl = 11 K, Th = 26 °C the result is 3.3 % (ceiling on cycle efficiency for a total 21 K less 11 K of temperature losses with warm water at 26 °C). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 有效溫差與實際效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective temperature difference and real efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效溫差與實際效率」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Effective temperature difference and real efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η = (ΔT − ΔT_loss) / T_h；代入 dT = 21 K、dl = 11 K、Th = 26 °C，得 3.3 %（總溫差 21 K、各項溫差損失合計 11 K、暖水 26 °C 時循環的效率上限）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 dl 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η = (ΔT − ΔT_loss) / T_h; with dT = 21 K, dl = 11 K, Th = 26 °C the result is 3.3 % (ceiling on cycle efficiency for a total 21 K less 11 K of temperature losses with warm water at 26 °C). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise dl by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：dl 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.0 %（-11.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising dl by 10% changes the result to 3.0 % (-11.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 3.3 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 dl 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 3.3 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in dl with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η = (ΔT − ΔT_loss) / T_h；代入 dT = 21 K、dl = 11 K、Th = 26 °C，得 3.3 %（總溫差 21 K、各項溫差損失合計 11 K、暖水 26 °C 時循環的效率上限）。
knowledge.textEn: η = (ΔT − ΔT_loss) / T_h; with dT = 21 K, dl = 11 K, Th = 26 °C the result is 3.3 % (ceiling on cycle efficiency for a total 21 K less 11 K of temperature losses with warm water at 26 °C).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: dl 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.0 %（-11.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising dl by 10% changes the result to 3.0 % (-11.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效溫差與實際效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量測海水與氨在兩座熱交換器進出口的溫度，逐項求出各部分所消耗的溫差。
從一千公尺深抽水，要花的電比發的電還多。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Temperatures of seawater and ammonia at inlets and outlets of both exchangers give the temperature difference each part consumes.
Pumping water from a thousand metres deep takes more power than is generated.
quiz.explanation: 量測海水與氨在兩座熱交換器進出口的溫度，逐項求出各部分所消耗的溫差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperatures of seawater and ammonia at inlets and outlets of both exchangers give the temperature difference each part consumes. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效溫差與實際效率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective temperature difference and real efficiency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效溫差與實際效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective temperature difference and real efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測海水與氨在兩座熱交換器進出口的溫度，逐項求出各部分所消耗的溫差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Temperatures of seawater and ammonia at inlets and outlets of both exchangers give the temperature difference each part consumes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：循環設計要把每一度溫差當成稀缺資源來分配，以整廠的淨出力與成本決定各處的端差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Allocate every degree as a scarce resource in cycle design, setting each approach from net output and cost of the whole plant.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了節省熱交換器而把端差放大一度，可用的溫差就少了一成，全廠的出力也跟著少一成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Widening the approach by one degree to save exchanger area takes a tenth off available difference and a tenth off plant output. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測海水與氨在兩座熱交換器進出口的溫度，逐項求出各部分所消耗的溫差。
knowledge.textEn: Temperatures of seawater and ammonia at inlets and outlets of both exchangers give the temperature difference each part consumes.

knowledge.text: 循環設計要把每一度溫差當成稀缺資源來分配，以整廠的淨出力與成本決定各處的端差。
knowledge.textEn: Allocate every degree as a scarce resource in cycle design, setting each approach from net output and cost of the whole plant.

quiz.question: 在「有效溫差與實際效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective temperature difference and real efficiency" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
海水到處都是，要用多少都不成問題。
為了節省熱交換器而把端差放大一度，可用的溫差就少了一成，全廠的出力也跟著少一成。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Seawater is everywhere and any amount can be used without trouble.
Widening the approach by one degree to save exchanger area takes a tenth off available difference and a tenth off plant output.
quiz.explanation: 為了節省熱交換器而把端差放大一度，可用的溫差就少了一成，全廠的出力也跟著少一成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Widening the approach by one degree to save exchanger area takes a tenth off available difference and a tenth off plant output. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 有效溫差與實際效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective temperature difference and real efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效溫差與實際效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Effective temperature difference and real efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了節省熱交換器而把端差放大一度，可用的溫差就少了一成，全廠的出力也跟著少一成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「海水溫差發電熱交換器」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Widening the approach by one degree to save exchanger area takes a tenth off available difference and a tenth off plant output. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion Heat Exchangers”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：扣掉之後，氨蒸汽在渦輪機進出口之間真正可用的溫差只剩十度左右——理論效率因此由百分之七掉到百分之三出頭，還沒有扣掉抽水的耗電。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After them the difference really available to ammonia vapour across the turbine is only about ten degrees, and theoretical efficiency falls from seven percent to a little over three, before pumping power is taken off.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海水有二十度的溫差，就全部可以用來發電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With twenty degrees between waters, all of it is available for power." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
